name: Villahermosa (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villahermosa (a scallop and a cross of Saint James on red).
history: Municipal flag of Villahermosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villahermosa arms — scallop and cross of Saint James on red
